PAGE.TITLE: Devin
PAGE.CONTENT:
Installation
Devin Desktop
Executable / application files
User install (default): %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\Devin (i.e. C:\Users\<Username>\AppData\Local\Programs\Devin)
System-Wide install: C:\Program Files\Devin
User data & settings:
%APPDATA%\Devin (i.e. C:\Users\<Username>\AppData\Roaming\Devin)
Global settings / cache: %USERPROFILE%\.devin (i.e. C:\Users\<Username>\.devin)
Devin CLI
Executable binary
Standalone / script installations place the binary in %LOCALAPPDATA%\devin\bin\ or %USERPROFILE%\.devin\bin\.
If installed via a global package manager, it will reside in the package manager’s bin directory (e.g., %APPDATA%\npm\ or %LOCALAPPDATA%\pnpm\).
Configuration Files:
User config: %APPDATA%\devin\config.json (i.e. C:\Users\<Username>\AppData\Roaming\devin\config.json)
MCP config %APPDATA%\devin\mcp_config.json
Project-Level Config (per repository): <project_root>\.devin\config.json and <project_root>\.devin\mcp_config.json
Logs
%APPDATA%\devin\cli\logs\ (i.e. C:\Users\<Username>\AppData\Roaming\devin\cli\logs\)
Command line
devin help
devin --help Display help.
devin update Check for updates and optionally install them.
devin -p "prompt"
devin -p -- prompt words here Print response and exit.
devin -c
devin --continue Continue the most recent session in the current directory.
devin -r
devin --resume Pick from recent sessions.
devin -r brisk-otter Resume a specific session by ID.
devin skills list List all available skills.
devin skills list --trigger user List all available user-triggerable skills (defined in the skill’s frontmatter).
devin skills list --trigger model List all available model-triggerable skills (defined in the skill’s frontmatter).
devin skills show <name> Show details for a specific skill.
devin skills paths Show skill directory locations
Slash commands (dochttps://docs.devin.ai/cli/essential-commands#slash-commands
enHTML)
/exit
/quit Exit the CLI.
